sources.facts: The municipal heritage office lists the No. 19 compound and the national historic No. 21 house, three north rooms, three south rooms, two eastern and two western rooms.

The article by the museum research office identifies the 8 square metre northward annex at the centre of the north range, used as the author’s study and bedroom, and the north, south and side room functions.
Beijing distinguishes the preserved housing and the museum to its east.
Beijing records the black lacquer street entrance edged in gilt, red room doors and windows, plus the lilacs grown by Lu Xun himself.
